title: Marina-Front 3-Bedroom Home for Sale in Puerto Aventuras
subtitle: Mediterranean Colonial Home with Private Boat Slip
description:
The Admiralty Villa
Embracing the timeless elegance of Mediterranean Colonial architecture, this marina-front residence stands as a testament to the classic coastal lifestyle of Puerto Aventuras. Bathed in natural light and perfectly positioned in the heart of the community, the home offers a rare sense of arrival where the water feels like a natural extension of your living room.

A Private Anchorage
Designed for those who find peace on the water, the property features a private 49-foot boat slip, allowing you to dock your vessel directly at your doorstep. Whether returning from a day on the Caribbean or preparing for a sunset departure, the convenience of this deep-water access is unparalleled.

The Space & Vision
The villa comprises three spacious bedroom suites and three and a half bathrooms, maintaining a sophisticated balance of privacy and openness. With its solid construction, private pool, and secure indoor garage, the residence provides a robust and elegant foundation. It is a rare canvas awaiting a personal touch to elevate it into a world-class tropical retreat.

The Community Lifestyle
Living here means immersion in the Riviera Maya’s premier gated enclave. Residents enjoy effortless access to two full-service marinas, a championship golf course, and exclusive beach clubs. From the bilingual school to the fine dining of the marina village, every necessity is within reach, secured by 24/7 world-class security.
highlights: Prime proximity to beaches and dining
Walking distance to beach and amenities
Access to golf course and beach club
